subquery: What are the estimated compliance costs for startups under 50 employees?

summary.value: Industry estimates put compliance costs for SMEs at EUR 25,000–50,000 for initial setup under the EU AI Act, with ongoing annual costs of EUR 5,000–15,000 depending on risk tier. High-risk system providers face significantly higher costs due to mandatory third-party audits.

sources.title: EU regulatory framework for AI - European Commission
